result:
Round 227 is implemented with no STOP, but I added two test assertions that B's §2.1 list does not include, so B needs to rule on them (deviation D1, details below). All my own checks pass, and the full suite and `verify` are left for the root gate.

**What changed (only the 5 granted files; `StudioWorkspace.tsx` untouched):**
- **Gate failure fix:** the selected-clip case in `track-layout.test.tsx` no longer checks styling classes. It now checks that the placeholder, the selected-clip line and the "Keyboard shortcuts (?)" button sit together in one footer row, and that the row stays the same after selecting and deselecting.
- **Sheet wording (C-R226-02/03):** the `fit` row now shows "Double-click the overview" and "Double-click the ruler (no selection)". The `waveform-zoom` row now shows "Waveform Zoom menu".
- **SC4:** a new test in `shortcuts.test.ts` checks both rows and that no key mentions a "button".
- **UC12:** the test title is renamed; its body is unchanged.
- **Doc 177:** the status line now reads round 227, with two new problem → solution entries.

**Deviation D1:** the code-reviewer pointed out that the row check would still pass if the row wrapper were removed. Its suggested fix (the button's parent is the row) did not catch that: a test that removes the wrapper (MU-4) stayed green. I added a check that the row has exactly 2 children, and with it MU-4 fails. This stays inside the granted test case. The catch is that CALM-2/3 will change this footer row; `track-layout.test.tsx` must be in their pre-check and covering set, or this check will break the gate again. If B prefers, a check that doesn't depend on the child count is an option; I haven't made it.

**Checks I ran:**
- Biome is clean on the 4 changed code and test files.
- typecheck, lint and build all succeed. Lint's 205 warnings are pre-existing, none in my files.
- The 8 covering test files passed, 104 tests. After the D1 edit I re-ran only `track-layout.test.tsx` (36/36).
- The four planted breakages (MU-1 to MU-4) each turned a test red; I restored each file and confirmed its hash afterwards.
- No test is near its timeout: the slowest took 2.7 s against a 20 s limit.
- In the browser at 1280×720 and 1440×900, each new key fits on one line, the sheet does not overflow sideways, and there are no page errors.
- Ten paths are changed. HEAD and the frozen, carried and root-file hash lists are unchanged, and the protected files are untouched.

**Code review:** 9/10, with no Critical, High or Medium findings and no architecture note. Three Lows go to B because they fall outside my grants:
- "(no selection)" would be exact as "(no time selection)": a selected clip with no time range still fits.
- The waveform zoom control visibly shows only "1×/2×…"; the "Waveform Zoom" name appears only on hover.
- Doc 177's file list and test list are stale outside the lines I was allowed to edit.

C's acceptance rows have not been run yet, so nothing there is claimed. CALM-1a is not done until C passes and the gate succeeds.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-227.md`; the logs, end hashes, hunk diff and screenshots are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-227/`.
